hook.line: On-screen text: 3 machine learning projects you can finish in a weekend, sports edition.
hook.visual: A hand fidgets at a laptop in a letterboxed frame, then fast cuts to a printed research paper and a 3D distribution plot, under teal list text.

beats.what: Title text '3 machine learning projects you can finish in a weekend / sports edition' over a hand at a keyboard.
Rapid cuts every half second between a research paper and 3D plots, filmed off a monitor.
Project 1, match predictor (any sport), over a football prediction paper and a correlation heatmap.
Project 2, baseball pitch prediction, over a pitch scatter plot and a 'Pitch Predictor' app with a bar chart.
Project 3, football expected goals, over a match dashboard with a cumulative xG line chart.
Cut to the creator in a library at his laptop with 'Make sure to follow for more project ideas'.

why_it_works: A 12 s video with a 1.27 s median shot is easy to watch twice, and the long caption holds the full plan so viewers pause or save.
Each list item is paired with a finished-looking chart or dashboard, so the result is shown before any explanation.
No speech, only music and text, so it works muted and reads at a glance.
weaknesses: Text is tiny (2% median height) and 72% falls outside the safe area; the list is hard to read on a phone.
Screens are filmed off a monitor in the dark, so the charts are blurry and skewed.
The caption lists different projects (churn, house price, fraud) than the video's sports projects.
for_robert: Pair each listed item with one finished result on screen (a chart, a dashboard); avoid filming monitors in the dark and tiny text a phone can't read.
